title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Seats may not be Properly Attached to Wall (7 affected)

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Passenger Air Bag Inflator May Rupture (250,896 affected)
summary: Chrysler Group LLC (Chrysler) is recalling certain model year 2004-2005 Dodge Ram 1500, 2500, and 3500, 2004-2005 Dodge Durango, 2005 Dodge Dakota, 2005 Dodge Magnum and 2005 Chrysler 300, 300C and 300 SRT8 vehicles originally sold, or ever registered, in geographic locations associated with high absolute humidity. summary: Prevost Cars, Inc.(Prevost) is recalling certain model year 2009-2011 XL2, XL2 Shells, X3 Shell Converted Coaches, and X3 motorcoaches manufactured January 1, 2009, to December 31, 2011, and equipped with an automatic fire suppression system (AFSS) pressure tank in the engine compartment. title: Halcore Group, Inc.: Bracket for Suspension Fluid Tank may Fracture (55 affected)

The affected vehicles are equipped with LiquidSpring-brand aftermarket suspension kits. summary: H&H Sports Protection (H&H) is recalling certain VCAN V528 helmets size XL manufactured April 1, 2008, to October 9, 2014. title: Starcraft RV: Incorrect Tire Label Information/FMVSS 110 (32 affected)

title: Ford Motor Company: Passenger Front Air Bag Inflator May Rupture (410 affected)

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Side Curtain Air Bag Improper Inflation (1,252 affected)
summary: American Honda Motor Co. title: BMW of North America, LLC: Transmission Software may Result in Rollaway (1,928 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain model year 2014-2015 MINI Cooper Hardtop 2 Door, and Cooper S Hardtop 2 Door vehicles manufactured January 6, 2014, to October 17, 2014.  During service appointments, dealers may have inadvertently reprogrammed the transmission control unit with software that may allow drivers to exit the vehicle when the transmission is not in Park.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 114, "Theft Protection and Rollaway Prevention."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Insufficient Headlight Output (25,007 affected)

"Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain model year 2012 FXST103, FLSTC, FLSTC103, FLSTF, FLSTF103, FXDL, FXDWG, FXDWG103, FXDC, FXDB, FLSTN, FLSTN103, FLSTC103Shrine, FLSTFB, FLSTFB103, FXS, FXS103, FLS, FLS103, FLD, FLD103, FXDF, and FXDF103 Dyna and Softail motorcycles manufactured August 22, 2011, through February 24, 2012. title: Blue Bird Body Company: Parking Brake Pedal Separation (304 affected)

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Fuel Filter Shell may Separate and Cause Stall (12 affected)

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: Shift Selector Moved From Park (60,823 affected)
summary: Suzuki Motor of America, Inc.
